note: The stated actor coordinates follow directly from p_z-p_v=D, p_o-p_v=E, p_f-p_v=-AD+tE, and p_w-p_v=a(p_f-p_v). Since all actor y-values lie in [0,1] and the y-coordinate is affine on the plane spanned by D and E, every convex combination of the actor points also has y-coordinate in [0,1]. Thus regime (i) implies regime (ii), so the alternatives overlap and cannot form an exclusive dichotomy.
